name: _rendered.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  docs/_rendered.scss — rendered content surfaces — GitHub-style markdown, JSON trees, sanitized HTML reports.
//  Imported by docs.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

.#{$_B_DOCS} {
  // ── Rendered content — markdown, JSON trees, sanitized html reports ──
  &-content {
    overflow: auto;
    max-width: 100%;

    // Generic element styling for markdown payloads — rendered html
    // reports (.docs-html) keep their own inlined styles instead.
    .docs-md {
      max-width: 75ch;
      line-height: 1.6;
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);

      @include layout-960() {
        font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      h1,
      h2 {
        border-bottom: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xs);
        font-weight: 200;
      }

      h3,
      h4,
      h5,
      h6 {
        font-weight: 300;
      }

      a {
        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-underline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
      }

      code {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: 0.9em;
        background: var(--bg-secondary);
        padding: to-rem($space-3xs) to-rem($space-2xs);
        border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
      }

      pre {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
        line-height: 1.5;
        padding: to-rem($space-md);
        overflow: auto;
        background: var(--bg-secondary);
        border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);

        code {
          background: none;
          padding: 0;
        }
      }

      table {
        border-collapse: collapse;
        width: 100%;
        font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
        display: block;
        overflow-x: auto;

        th,
        td {
          border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
          padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm);
          text-align: left;
        }

        th {
          background: var(--bg-secondary);
        }

        tr:nth-child(even) td {
          background: var(--bg-secondary);
        }
      }

      blockquote {
        border-left: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
        margin: to-rem($space-sm) 0;
        padding-left: to-rem($space-md);
        opacity: 0.8;
      }

      ul,
      ol {
        padding-left: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      hr {
        border: 0;
        border-top: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
        opacity: 0.4;
        margin: to-rem($space-lg) 0;
      }

      img {
        max-width: 100%;
        height: auto;
      }
    }

    // Sanitized html reports (istanbul coverage, generated docs): their
    // body/html selectors are remapped onto this wrapper at render time and
    // their `!important`s stripped, so the themed overrides below fully own
    // the report surface — it follows the app's light/dark toggle through
    // the --cov-* tokens instead of the report's baked light hexes.
    .docs-html {
      max-width: none;
      padding: to-rem($space-md);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border-radius: var(--radius-md);
      color: var(--text-primary);
      overflow: auto;

      // Report chrome — ink, links, quiet text and the fraction chips.
      a {
        color: var(--cov-link);
      }

      div.path a:link,
      div.path a:visited {
        color: var(--text-primary);
      }

      .quiet,
      .ignore-none {
        color: var(--text-secondary);
      }

      // istanbul halves link opacity inside .quiet — the blend drops the
      // themed link ink below WCAG AA against the dark surface, so the
      // footer link stays full-strength (already AAA via --cov-link).
      .quiet a {
        opacity: 1;
      }

      .fraction {
        background: var(--cov-fraction-bg);
        color: var(--cov-fraction-ink);
      }

      pre.prettyprint {
        border-color: var(--cov-border);
      }

      // Sort arrows — istanbul paints them from a sprite png (unreachable
      // inside the payload sandbox); themed border-triangles inherit the
      // header ink instead. Unsorted columns show nothing.
      .coverage-summary .sorter::after {
        content: '';
        display: inline-block;
        border: to-rem($space-2xs) solid transparent;
      }

      .coverage-summary .sorted .sorter::after {
        border-bottom-color: currentColor;
      }

      .coverage-summary .sorted-desc .sorter::after {
        border-top-color: currentColor;
      }

      .coverage-summary td.empty {
        color: var(--text-muted);
      }

      // Table/grid borders — istanbul's #bbb/#ddd hairlines.
      .coverage-summary tbody,
      .coverage-summary td,
      .coverage-summary tr,
      .keyline-all {
        border-color: var(--cov-border);
      }

      // Status fills — soft tints on rows, mid fills on stat cells,
      // strong swatches on the status bar/chart borders.
      .status-line.low,
      .low .cover-fill {
        background: var(--cov-low-strong);
      }

      .low .chart {
        border-color: var(--cov-low-strong);
      }

      .highlighted,
      .highlighted .cstat-no,
      .highlighted .fstat-no,
      .highlighted .cbranch-no {
        background: var(--cov-low-strong);
      }

      .cstat-no,
      .fstat-no {
        background: var(--cov-low-mid);
      }

      .low,
      .cline-no {
        background: var(--cov-low-soft);
      }

      .high,
      .cline-yes {
        background: var(--cov-high-soft);
      }

      .cstat-yes {
        background: var(--cov-high-mid);
      }

      .status-line.high,
      .high .cover-fill {
        background: var(--cov-high-strong);
      }

      .high .chart {
        border-color: var(--cov-high-strong);
      }

      .status-line.medium,
      .medium .cover-fill {
        background: var(--cov-med-strong);
      }

      .medium .chart {
        border-color: var(--cov-med-strong);
      }

      .medium {
        background: var(--cov-med-soft);
      }

      .cbranch-no {
        background: var(--cov-warn);
        color: var(--text-primary);
      }

      .cstat-skip,
      .fstat-skip,
      .cbranch-skip {
        background: var(--cov-skip);
        color: var(--text-primary);
      }

      .cline-neutral {
        background: var(--cov-neutral);
      }

      .missing-if-branch {
        background: var(--cov-missing-bg);
        color: var(--cov-missing-ink);
      }

      // The uncovered-region marker keeps its dark slab + yellow ink in
      // both themes — the strongest possible "needs attention" signal.
      .cover-empty {
        background: var(--bg-primary);
      }

      // Source-line zebra stripes (prettify's even-line marker).
      li.L1,
      li.L3,
      li.L5,
      li.L7,
      li.L9 {
        background: var(--cov-stripe);
      }

      // Prettify syntax inks — the inlined stylesheet ships light-only
      // colors; the --cov-syn-* tokens keep them legible in both themes.
      .pln {
        color: var(--text-primary);
      }

      .str,
      .atv {
        color: var(--cov-syn-str);
      }

      .kwd,
      .tag {
        color: var(--cov-syn-kwd);
      }

      .com {
        color: var(--cov-syn-com);
      }

      .typ,
      .atn,
      .dec,
      .var {
        color: var(--cov-syn-typ);
      }

      .lit {
        color: var(--cov-syn-lit);
      }

      .pun,
      .opn,
      .clo {
        color: var(--cov-syn-pun);
      }

      .fun {
        color: var(--cov-syn-fun);
      }

      // Istanbul report regions are min-content wide (the 5-metric
      // summary table ~840px, code <pre> wider): give each its own
      // scrollport so the title, stat row, hints and filter stay
      // viewport-fit instead of pushing the whole pane sideways.
      table.coverage-summary,
      pre {
        display: block;
        overflow-x: auto;
        max-width: 100%;
        overscroll-behavior-inline: contain;
      }

      // Long file paths wrap inside their cell rather than widening it.
      table.coverage-summary td,
      table.coverage-summary td a {
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }

      // Mobile: the istanbul .pad1/.pad2/.padN-space chrome + our own
      // padding shrink so the report's readable area keeps most of a
      // narrow viewport; nowrap cells release so paths wrap instead of
      // forcing a second scroll axis on the summary table.
      @media (max-width: $bk-768) {
        padding: to-rem($space-2xs);

        .pad1,
        .pad2 {
          padding: to-rem($space-2xs);
        }

        .pad2x {
          padding-right: to-rem($space-2xs);
          padding-left: to-rem($space-2xs);
        }

        .space-left2 {
          padding-left: to-rem($space-md);
        }

        .space-right2 {
          padding-right: to-rem($space-2xs);
        }

        table.coverage td.line-count {
          padding-right: to-rem($space-2xs);
          padding-left: to-rem($space-sm);
        }

        table.coverage-summary td.file {
          white-space: normal;
        }
      }
    }

    // Parsed JSON surface — real numbers, key/field rows and tables.
    .docs-json {
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
      max-width: 75ch;

      @include layout-960() {
        font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      .docs-json-obj {
        margin: 0;
      }

      .docs-json-row {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(to-rem($space-6xl), auto) 1fr;
        gap: to-rem($space-md);
        padding: to-rem($space-3xs) 0;
        border-bottom: to-rem($space-3xs) dotted color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 30%, transparent);
        align-items: baseline;

        > dt {
          font-family: var(--font-mono);
          font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
          color: var(--text-secondary);
          overflow-wrap: anywhere;
        }

        > dd {
          margin: 0;
          min-width: 0;
          overflow-x: auto;
        }

        // Nested groups indent under their key.
        > dd .docs-json-obj,
        > dd .docs-json-table,
        > dd .docs-json-list {
          margin: to-rem($space-3xs) 0;
        }
      }

      .docs-json-num {
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
        font-weight: 400;
      }

      .docs-json-str {
        color: var(--text-secondary);
        overflow-wrap: anywhere;
      }

      .docs-json-bool,
      .docs-json-null {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        opacity: 0.8;
      }

      .docs-json-table {
        border-collapse: collapse;
        font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
        display: block;
        overflow-x: auto;

        th,
        td {
          border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
          padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm);
          text-align: left;
          vertical-align: top;
        }

        th {
          background: var(--bg-secondary);
          font-family: var(--font-mono);
        }

        // Pivot tables (coverage-summary shape) — the outer key is the row
        // header; long file paths wrap instead of stretching the table.
        th[scope='row'] {
          font-weight: 400;
          color: var(--text-secondary);
          overflow-wrap: anywhere;
          max-width: 45ch;
        }
      }

      // Compact `key value` stat pairs inside pivot cells — a flat coverage
      // group (total/covered/skipped/pct) reads on one line, wrapping as a
      // block between pairs rather than mid-pair.
      .docs-json-kv {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
        margin-right: to-rem($space-sm);
        white-space: nowrap;

        &:last-child {
          margin-right: 0;
        }
      }

      .docs-json-k {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        font-size: to-rem($space-md);
        color: var(--text-secondary);
        opacity: 0.8;
      }

      // Meters shrink inside cells so a 4-column coverage table stays compact.
      .docs-json-kv .docs-json-pct-bar,
      .docs-json-table td .docs-json-pct-bar {
        width: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      .docs-json-list {
        margin: 0;
        padding-left: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      // Percentage meter — the coverage-summary "real numbers" treatment.
      .docs-json-pct {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
        font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
      }

      .docs-json-pct-bar {
        display: inline-block;
        width: to-rem($space-4xl);
        height: to-rem($space-sm);
        background: var(--bg-secondary);
        border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid currentColor;
        border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        vertical-align: middle;

        &::before {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          inset: 0;
          width: calc(var(--docs-json-pct) * 1%);
          background: currentColor;
          opacity: 0.7;
        }
      }

      .docs-json-nest,
      .docs-json-empty,
      .docs-json-more {
        font-family: var(--font-mono);
        opacity: 0.6;
      }

      .docs-json-link {
        color: inherit;
      }
    }

    // Mermaid diagrams — a themed surface; edge paths get a slow marching
    // dash so flowcharts read as living flows (the "fully animated"
    // contract), tuned subtle like the rest of the backdrop.
    .docs-mermaid {
      padding: to-rem($space-md);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
      overflow-x: auto;
      text-align: center;

      // No max-width scaling — the block's overflow-x:auto scrolls wide
      // diagrams instead of shrinking them (scaled-down diagrams render
      // unreadably small text).
      svg {
        display: inline-block;
      }

      .edgePath path,
      .flowchart-link,
      .edgePaths .path {
        stroke-dasharray: to-rem($space-sm) to-rem($space-2xs);
        animation: #{$_B_DOCS}-edge-flow 6s linear infinite;
      }

      .node rect,
      .node circle,
      .node polygon,
      .cluster rect {
        transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
      }

      // In-place skeleton while the mermaid chunk + render run — keeps
      // the block's surface and reads as work-in-progress, not a code
      // dump. The shimmer sweeps on the same slow cadence as edge-flow.
      .docs-mermaid-loading {
        @extend .txt-xs;

        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        letter-spacing: 0.15em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        opacity: 0.55;
        padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-md);

        &::after {
          content: '';
          position: absolute;
          inset: 0;
          background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 30%, currentColor 48%, transparent 62%);
          background-size: 300% 300%;
          opacity: 0.08;
          animation: #{$_B_DOCS}-drift 2.4s linear infinite;
        }
      }
    }

    @keyframes #{$_B_DOCS}-edge-flow {
      to {
        stroke-dashoffset: to-rem($space-xl);
      }
    }

    // Readability surface for source/text payloads — the "ts files need a
    // background" contract: theme-aware --bg-secondary on --text-primary.
    .docs-code {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);
      line-height: 1.5;
      padding: to-rem($space-md);
      overflow: auto;
      white-space: pre;
      tab-size: 2;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);
      border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 20%, transparent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-2xs);
    }
  }
}
